item.title: Gov. Tony Evers signs off on new PFAS, lead regulations
item.description: Gov. Tony Evers announced Monday that he’s signed off on bringing Wisconsin’s PFAS and lead regulations in line with federal drinking water standards. The post Gov. Tony Evers signs off on new PFAS, lead regulations appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin author’s debut middle grade novel is an epic Indigenous fantasy
item.description: Christopher Roubique's debut middle grade novel “Mythspeaker” is inspired by Indigenous folktales. In it, Roubique draws from his Cajun and rural Wisconsin roots to explore themes of teamwork, self-worth and respect for nature. The post Wisconsin author’s debut middle grade novel is an epic Indigenous fantasy appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Report: Nearly half of Wisconsin’s lowest performing schools are on Milwaukee’s north side
item.description: Nearly half of Wisconsin’s lowest-performing schools are located on Milwaukee’s north side, according to a new report. The post Report: Nearly half of Wisconsin’s lowest performing schools are on Milwaukee’s north side appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin National Guard members supporting military operations in the Middle East
item.description: More than 400 members of the Wisconsin Army National Guard are stationed in the Middle East during the ongoing military action against Iran. The post Wisconsin National Guard members supporting military operations in the Middle East appeared first on WPR.

item.title: UW-Madison dance major — the first in the nation — turns 100
item.description: In 1926, the idea of studying dance as an academic pursuit was almost unheard of. But one Wisconsin woman’s unique approach to teaching dance changed the field forever. The post UW-Madison dance major — the first in the nation — turns 100 appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Tribes, gambling companies at odds over bill legalizing online sports betting in Wisconsin
item.description: If the bill becomes law, Wisconsin tribes interested in offering online sports betting "would need to renegotiate" their gaming compacts with the state. And those compacts would need to be approved by the federal government. The post Tribes, gambling companies at odds over bill legalizing online sports betting in Wisconsin appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Despite US climate retreat, Bayfield County is making millions from carbon credits
item.description: After meeting certification standards, the county’s forests are now producing seven-figure returns. The post Despite US climate retreat, Bayfield County is making millions from carbon credits appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Faced with court backlog, lawmakers aim to add more lawyers, judges statewide
item.description: The proposal to add more than 100 court positions is awaiting approval by Wisconsin's Republican-controlled Senate, after clearing the GOP-led Assembly in February. The post Faced with court backlog, lawmakers aim to add more lawyers, judges statewide appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Evers calls for special session to ban partisan gerrymandering
item.description: Gov. Tony Evers has ordered Wisconsin lawmakers to return for a special session next month to consider a constitutional amendment aimed at ending partisan gerrymandering in state legislative districts. The post Evers calls for special session to ban partisan gerrymandering appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin could expand newly-implemented school cell phone ban
item.description: A new Republican proposal would require schools to adopt a “bell-to-bell” ban on cell phones by July 1, 2027. The post Wisconsin could expand newly-implemented school cell phone ban appeared first on WPR.
